children: may test a support at $106.02 per barrel, a break below which could trigger a fall toward $103.83.
Monday's bounce may have been driven by wave b, the second wave of a correction from $109.91. This wave could complete below this Sept. 11 high, then reverse on the downward wave c.
Immediate resistance is at $108.59, a break above which could trigger a fade into $109.58-$110.18. A further rise above $110.18 could signal the uptrend's continuation toward $112.75.

On the daily chart, a dark cloud cover formed between Sept. 10 and Sept. 11, suggesting a drop on Monday. This bearish reversal pattern appeared around a key resistance at $110.24, the 100% projection level of a wave C from $78.19.
The coincidence increases the chance of a drop toward the $98-$102.67 range.
